Install helium-browser on Omarchy

Private, fast, and honest web browser based on Chromium (Latest/Stable)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add helium-browser-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.20.1.1-1:
    pacman -Qi helium-browser-bin

Open and use helium-browser

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql helium-browser-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install helium-browser on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add helium-browser-bin. The download is 164.8 MB and it takes 408.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is helium-browser free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed GPL-3.0-only AND BSD-3-Clause.

How do I uninstall helium-browser?

Run omarchy pkg drop helium-browser-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does helium-browser depend on?

The package declares 12 dependencies: alsa-lib, dbus, gtk3, hicolor-icon-theme, libcups, libpulse, libva, libxss, nss, ttf-liberation, udev, xdg-utils. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is helium-browser in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as helium-browser-bin (version 0.20.1.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. imputnet makes it. Project site: https://github.com/imputnet/helium-linux.
